responsibility: This implementation module provides the stubbed-out body of the minimal GNU Modula-2 runtime used for gm2-libs-min. It imports libc and SYSTEM to force those support units into the link, and defines empty implementations of the standard runtime hooks declared in M2RTS.def—module construction/destruction, registration, dependency recording, init/fini execution, HALT, and NoException—so generated Modula-2 programs satisfy linker expectations without pulling in the full runtime initialization and exception machinery.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the M2RTS pair: it defines the no-op bodies for the runtime hooks declared in M2RTS.def and imports libc and SYSTEM to pull those support units into the link, rather than declaring the ABI surface.
